Chess Player Magnus Carlsen Forfeits Games, Sparks Controversy

Grandmaster Magnus Carlsen has forfeited two consecutive games against Bibisara Assaubayeva in a chess tournament, a move that has stirred controversy. The reasons behind Carlsen's forfeits are not explicitly detailed in the coverage, but the action has been described as a 'meaningless game' by one outlet. The FIDE (International Chess Federation) has responded to the situation, with details of their response provided in one report. Separately, in the race to the final of the same tournament, Giri and Firouzja have taken the lead.
